Contract tests BEFORE implementation (__tests__/pipeline/heritage-method-lookup.contract.test.ts): (a) `const a = new A(); a.fromBase()` with `class A extends Base` resolves EXACT to Base.fromBase with reason='heritage_method_lookup'; (b) multi-level chain (A extends B extends C, method on C) resolves through the chain; (c) heritage cycle (A extends B, B extends A) terminates without hang and leaves the prior classification; (d) `super.x()` resolves to the parent's method; super with heritage present but method absent yields 'super_method_not_in_heritage'; super with NO heritage facts keeps 'super_call_out_of_scope'; (e) inherited `this.x()` (method on parent, call in child) resolves via the chain; (f) OWN method shadows inherited same-name (nearest-definition-wins, existing branch-1/3 exact resolution unchanged); (g) external/unknown supertype (extends from an unimported or external name) leaves the result exactly as today - no fabricated edges; (h) same-ancestor-name multi-file collisions yield ambiguous with candidates, never silent resolution; (i) annotation/param bindings (`const x: A`, `(x: A) =>`) get the same heritage walk as 'new' bindings.

Implement: new src/pipeline/heritage-index.ts (buildHeritageIndex: Map<subtypeName, supertype entries>; heritageMethodLookup: BFS up extends+implements with visited-set cycle guard + depth cap, per-level symbolTable lookup of `${ancestor}.${callee}` filtered scope==='method' && qualifierPath===[ancestor], nearest-level-wins shadowing, single->resolved / multi->ambiguous). Wire into call-resolver.ts: build the index in resolveCallsAgainstTable from state.heritage, thread into classifyMethodCall (optional param, default empty for direct test callers); branch 1 this.X() miss -> heritage walk before 'this_method_not_in_class'; branch 2 super.X() -> walk from enclosing class's parents (miss with heritage present -> 'super_method_not_in_heritage', no heritage -> unchanged 'super_call_out_of_scope'); branch 3 own-methods miss -> heritage walk BEFORE the ACG fall-through (all three binding kinds). Fires ONLY where today's result is a miss/fall-through - no existing exact resolution is ever displaced.

phases.name: incremental path-keying fix (fact-set key normalization + rescan-form parity)

tasks.description: Confirm the defect chain end-to-end: populate.ts toAbs() absolutizes --changed-files/--deleted-files before runIncremental; orchestrator.runIncremental keys cached.byFile lookups + rescanned map by those ABSOLUTE paths; the persisted fact set (symbol-table-cache.ts buildFactSet) is keyed in whatever form the originating full build's projectPath produced - live store on this repo: projectPath='.', RELATIVE backslash keys. mergeChangedFacts therefore ADDS the changed file under a second (absolute) key instead of replacing its relative-keyed bundle -> same elements twice -> node_id_uniqueness duplicate -> fail-closed exit 1, graph unwritten (GX-002 P1-T6 plan_deviation repro, KZ-01KYY2S8, STUB-INDEXING-ORCHESTRATOR-PATH-NORMALIZATION-001 class). Also read coderef-watch.ts runIncrementalPopulate (the daemon spawn is a live consumer) and incremental-cache.ts (the OTHER incremental store - confirm in/out of scope).

BEFORE evidence: (a) reproduce the defect live against the current store - dist populate --changed-files on one file, expect exit 1 with node_id_uniqueness duplicate errors, capture the output tail as evidence in the WO dir; (b) capture metrics-p4-before.json (should be byte-equivalent to metrics-p3-after scalars - the full path is untouched this phase).

Contract tests BEFORE implementation (__tests__/pipeline/incremental-path-keying.contract.test.ts), fixture-driven via full build -> persisted fact set -> runIncremental: (a) ABSOLUTE changed-file path: incremental completes, zero duplicate element ids, and the resolved state is IDENTICAL to a from-scratch full rebuild of the same tree (element count + resolved-edge id set - the parity GX-002 could not prove); (b) RELATIVE changed-file path input: same result (both input forms accepted); (c) forward-slash separators on input normalize (Windows); (d) deleted-file eviction works with absolute input (file's elements gone from the merged universe); (e) brand-new file added incrementally appears exactly once; (f) missing/absent fact set still falls back to a full build (existing contract preserved); (g) a changed-file path OUTSIDE the project root is handled without corrupting the store (skipped or scanned, but never double-keyed).

Implement at the incremental seam (planning-gate design: mirror the CACHED set's form; do NOT globally absolutize orchestrator projectPath - that would churn every path-bearing id in existing artifacts): (i) symbol-table-cache.ts gains a canonical key helper (project-relative, separator-normalized) used for byFile lookup/merge key matching; (ii) orchestrator.runIncremental converts each incoming absolute path to the cached set's own key/label form (rel = relative(resolve(projectPath), abs); scan label = the form the originating build used, reconstructed from the stored set) so rescanned fact INTERNALS (element.file, import/call file fields) match the cached universe byte-for-byte; file READS resolve absolutely so cwd variance cannot break I/O; (iii) deletedFiles get the same canonicalization; (iv) mergeChangedFacts keying goes through the canonical helper so replace-not-add is guaranteed; (v) no FACT_SET_VERSION bump (shape unchanged; a form-mismatched legacy store is handled by canonicalization, not invalidation).

AFTER evidence: (a) the P4-T2 live repro now exits 0 and writes the graph; (b) E2E parity proof on the real repo: full rebuild vs incremental single-changed-file rebuild over the same tree -> identical resolved-edge id sets and scalars (the within-tree A/B, no cross-snapshot confound); (c) metrics-p4-after.json + metrics-p4-diff.md: full-path scalars UNCHANGED vs before (this phase is zero-flip on the full path by construction - guards: zero fabricated targets, zero lost resolutions, incremental==full).

Docs sync: CHANGELOG entry (incremental path-keying fix, parity now provable, GX-002 FU-4 closed); docs/ARCHITECTURE.md incremental section if it describes the keying; USING-CODEREF.md only if incremental guidance changes materially; record the p4_planning_gate design decision in communication.json decisions_log (seam-local mirror-the-cached-form over global absolutization, with rationale).

Full verification: new contract tests green; P1 test-dsl + P2 external-receiver + P3 heritage contract suites still green; tsc clean under both tsconfigs; full suite (isolate any 5s subprocess flakes by re-running failing files in isolation before calling them failures).
